name: cloud-relay
description: A visual, interactive demo of how AWS works end to end.

scripts.synth: npm run build -w @cloud-relay/web && npm run synth -w @cloud-relay/infra
scripts.diff: npm run build -w @cloud-relay/web && npm run diff -w @cloud-relay/infra
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w @cloud-relay/web && npm run deploy -w @cloud-relay/infra
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run synth
